name: render-policy-monorepo
description: Safe rendering of agent-generated content: sanitize to a DocumentFragment, insert without innerHTML, Trusted Types friendly, streaming aware.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/eslint-plugin -w packages/mcp-app-lint -w packages/react -w packages/mermaid -w packages/a2ui -w packages/angular
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:census && node --test "conformance/*.test.mjs" && npm run e2e && npm run corpus
scripts.e2e: node e2e/run.mjs && node e2e/url-parity.mjs && node packages/angular/e2e/run.mjs && node packages/mermaid/e2e/run.mjs && node packages/a2ui/e2e/run.mjs && node demo/build.mjs && node e2e/site.mjs && node conformance/run.mjs
